observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nasusunod ang bawat critical step ng lokal na demo checklist; tama ang placement at replacement ng dummy box; agad ang report at medical evaluation sa simulation.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Follows each critical step of the local demonstration checklist, places and replaces the dummy box correctly, and reports and obtains evaluation immediately in simulation.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Humahawak ng tunay na used sharps sa practice, lumalaktaw sa critical safety step o nagpapaliban ng medical evaluation.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses real used sharps in practice, misses a critical safety step or delays medical evaluation.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naobserbahan ng trainer ang lahat ng reviewed critical step sa ligtas na dummy demo, container placement/replacement cue, hand hygiene/PPE at agarang simulated report/evaluation bago documentation; walang prompt at tapat ang verification ng unknown contact/route.
levels.kaya_na_en: The trainer observes every reviewed critical step in safe dummy demonstration, container placement/replacement cue, hand hygiene/PPE and immediate simulated reporting/evaluation before documentation; no prompting and honest verification of unknown contacts/routes.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Ligtas ang attempt ngunit may prompt o kulang na clarification sa contact/route o checklist; itala ang tiyak na correction at obserbahan ang bagong retry.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: The attempt is safe but needs prompting or clarification of contact/route or checklist; record a specific correction and observe a fresh retry.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Humahawak ng tunay na used sharps sa practice, lumalaktaw sa critical safety step o nagpapaliban ng medical evaluation.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses real used sharps in practice, misses a critical safety step or delays medical evaluation.
